summary_rationale: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd possesses a genuine structural margin advantage in its 100-acre legacy Wadala i-Land township (near-zero historical land cost) and a 58-year execution brand (46,000+ homes delivered), which drove 5.1x PAT growth from FY21 (₹31 Cr) to FY26 (₹157 Cr) alongside record FY26 pre-sales of ₹1,701 Cr and collections of ₹1,103 Cr. Balance-sheet health improved materially via a ₹225 Cr preferential equity raise in FY25 and debt paydown to ₹646 Cr (0.44x D/E) by September 2026, earning a reaffirmed Crisil A-/Stable rating. However, the business remains inherently cyclical and working-capital-intensive: 12-year cumulative CFO (₹461 Cr) is only ~53% of cumulative PAT (₹870 Cr), 3-year average ROE is a modest 11.9% (ROCE 14.3%), and Kanjurmarg's leasehold-to-freehold conversion has suffered chronic regulatory slippage with potential cost escalation after December 2026. With H1 FY27 pre-sales at just ₹307 Cr against a ₹2,200 Cr full-year target and management guiding D/E back toward 1.0x to fund Q4 FY27 launches, execution on H2 launches and cash conversion remains a key watch item.
